sentences.text: 1 Licence of the petitioner was suspended by means of order dated 21.09.2023 in terms of the condition No.25 of the agreement for Fair Price Shop which provides suspension during the period a licensee is lodged in jail.
By means of the said order an explanation was also called from the petitioner.
The petitioner has been enlarged on bail by means of the order dated 22.09.2023 passed by the Sessions Judge, Hardoi in Bail Application No.2875 of 2023.
Thereafter the petitioner has moved a representation on 04.10.2023 to the Sub Divisional Officer, Hardoi for restoration of his licence, but till date no decision has been taken thereon.

Accordingly he makes an innocuous prayer for a direction to opposite party no.2/Sub Divisional Magistrate, Sadar, District-Hardoi to consider and dispose of the aforesaid representation of the petitioner within some short stipulated period, to which there is no objection to learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel.

In view of above, the petition is disposed of with direction to opposite party no.2/Sub Divisional Magistrate, Sadar, District-Hardoi to consider and dispose of the aforesaid representation of the petitioner dated 04.10.2023, contained in annexure no.5 to the writ petition, within a period of four weeks from the date of production of a certified copy of this order.
Consequences shall follow accordingly as per law.

.
